identity_binding.rule: Bind identity to the physical USB path plus the MAC/controller address. Interface names (wlan*, wlx*, hciN) and HCI indices are NOT stable across re-plugs and are recorded for information only; all tooling re-derives them from the anchors on every run.

expected_identity_until_insertion.note: SUPERSEDED_BY_LIVE_CAPTURE -- the adapter was physically present when this file was generated, so these values mirror live_capture and are kept only as the expected identity for the next insertion. If the adapter is absent on a later run, these are what discovery will match against.

primary_network_reference.note: see primary-network-baseline.txt; must never be disturbed

attachment_history.note: Historical evidence of the combo adapter's attachment. The first enumeration shows 'RTL: download fw command failed (-19)' followed by a re-enumeration in which the firmware loaded successfully ('RTL: fw version ...'), so -19 is an initial-attach artefact, not a hard failure.
